detail.topic: Doc toan bo docs/exchanges/2026-09-13.md truoc khi lam viec (dac biet khoi cuoi file 'Claude da nhan ban giao'), roi doc CR-20260913-nen-tang-da-nguoi-dung.md ban Claude vua sua. Bon viec can giai quyet dut diem: (1) Xac nhan hoac dinh chinh cach Claude dien giai Q7 cua Leader ve task nhieu nguoi phu trach - Claude hieu 'rut khoi task ap theo de xuat' nghia la Member tu rut duoc chinh minh nhung khong bot duoc nguoi khac; neu ban goc cua Council truoc y khac thi noi ro va Claude se sua lai CR. (2) FR-30 (bai thong bao release sinh ban tieng Nhat, tu dong doi gio VN sang JST, vi du 15:00 VN thanh 17:00 JST) hoan toan CHUA duoc 2 phien Council truoc (run 38c458f1, 4dd7a70c) cham toi vi ho chi tap trung bao mat/hieu nang chung - hay ra soat rieng FR-30 xem co mau thuan gi voi SEC-PERF-004 (session) hoac FR-45 (SQLite) khong, va dac biet kiem tra co nguy co lap lai dung loai loi da tung xay ra that trong du an nay hay khong (BUG-20260803 va BUG-20260804 - ca hai deu la loi gio MAY chu khong phai gio nguoi dung chon, xem docs/delivery/README.md muc 5 de doc chi tiet hai bug that do). (3) Doi chieu 49 FR (FR-1 den FR-49, ke ca cac muc co chu nhu FR-1a/FR-4a/FR-11a/FR-32a) voi 35 AC (AC-1 den AC-35, ke ca AC-2a) - liet ke ro FR nao chua co AC nao map toi. (4) FR-41 (route inventory 11 truong) duoc ghi la bat buoc TRUOC PILOT o bang phan ky trong CR, nhung bang 6 lat trien khai o cuoi CR (muc 10) hien chi gan FR-6 den FR-14 vao lat 3 va khong noi ro Nhom F (FR-40 den FR-49) thuoc lat nao - xac dinh Nhom F nen nam o lat nao trong 6 lat, co can tach them lat rieng cho phan bao mat/tai nguyen backend hay khong, va sua lai bang lat trong CR neu can. Day la CR con o trang thai 'Da review', DoR CHUA dat (thieu route inventory that va benchmark that) - khong duoc coi nhu da xong. Neu phat sinh cau hoi can Leader (nguoi dung that) tra loi, cu dat cau hoi ro rang trong turn_result, Leader se tra loi truc tiep qua Claude.
